question: What classes of beings is one claimed to become by the practice indicated in context?
premises: Becoming a divine maiden of the gods is claimed.
Becoming among yakṣas and vidyādharas is also claimed.
The claim is stated as a potential.
inference: The practice is claimed to enable becoming a divine maiden of the gods and/or a yakṣa-vidyādhara.
uncertainties: The exact practice is not named in this verse and must come from context.
plain_english: One may become a divine maiden of the gods, and also a yakṣa-vidyādhara.
